job.title: Electrical Shift Engineer
job.description:
Position: Electrical Shift Engineer
Location: Central London
Salary: £52,000 per annum + Overtime
Hours: 4 on / 4 off Shift Pattern (Days & Nights)
Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

A prestigious FM service provider is seeking an experienced Electrical Shift Engineer to join their on-site engineering team at a state-of-the-art commercial static site in Central London. This is a fantastic opportunity to work within a professional environment offering excellent training, career progression, and overtime opportunities.
 
What you'll do:
  • Carry out planned preventative maintenance (PPMs) and reactive maintenance across electrical building services systems.
  • Fault-find and repair electrical systems including lighting, power distribution, emergency lighting, control panels, and associated plant.
  • Complete routine inspections and testing to ensure electrical systems remain safe, compliant, and fully operational.
  • Respond to breakdowns and reactive maintenance requests, minimising disruption to site operations.
  • Support minor electrical works, system upgrades, and general engineering projects where required.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records and ensure all works are completed in line with health & safety and compliance requirements.
What you'll bring:
  • City & Guilds / NVQ qualification in an Electrical discipline.
  • Proven experience within commercial building services or facilities maintenance.
  • Strong electrical fault-finding and diagnostic skills.
  • Good understanding of commercial electrical systems and building services plant.
  • A proactive, reliable, and professional approach to maintenance.
Why Apply?
  • £52,000 per annum salary
  • 4 on / 4 off shift pattern covering days and nights
  • State-of-the-art commercial static site
  • Overtime opportunities available
  • Excellent training and progression opportunities
  • Stable, long-term role within a professional engineering environment
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Electrical Engineer looking for a unique shift role within a prestigious commercial environment, with genuine opportunities for training, progression, and increased earnings through overtime.

job.title: FM Contract (Wimbledon)
job.description:
FM Contract Support
Location: Wimbledon, London
Salary: £35,000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm
 
Are you an experienced FM Contract Support professional looking for your next opportunity within a leading facilities management company?
 
We are currently recruiting for an FM Contract Support to join a leading FM provider, working from a modern corporate office building in Wimbledon.
 
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous CAFM and facilities management experience who is looking to develop their career within a well-established organisation, with plenty of opportunities for further progression and development.
 
The Role
You will provide administrative and operational support across hard FM contracts, working closely with engineers, contract management and the wider facilities management team to ensure the smooth running of the contract.
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Providing day-to-day contract support to the FM team
  • Using CAFM systems to manage and track maintenance activities
  • Supporting the coordination of PPM and reactive maintenance
  • Raising and managing work orders and purchase orders
  • Assisting with reports, documentation and general contract administration
  • Liaising with engineers, clients, contractors and suppliers
  • Supporting the Contract Manager with the smooth delivery of FM services
  • Ensuring records and CAFM information are kept accurate and up to date
 
About You:
The ideal candidate will have:
  • Previous experience in FM Contract Support, Contract Administration or a similar FM role
  • Previous CAFM experience is essential
  • Good understanding of facilities management and hard services
  • Strong organisational and administrative skills
  • Excellent communication skills and attention to detail
  • A proactive approach and ability to manage multiple tasks
 
What's On Offer?
 
  • £35,000 per annum
  • Monday to Friday, 8am-5pm
  • Office-based role in a modern corporate environment
  • Based in Wimbledon
  • Working for a leading FM company
  • Excellent opportunities for career progression and development
  • Opportunity to build a long-term career within the FM industry
 
If you're an experienced FM Contract Support professional with CAFM experience and are looking for a role with a company that genuinely offers progression, this could be an excellent opportunity for you.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Mechanical Engineer looking for a stable commercial position with a prestigious employer, while benefiting from genuine training, progression, and overtime opportunities.
